messages:
anya: Quick heads-up: saved view I made from Route /converse that pinned model gpt-lite isn't appearing on the Model page. Route listing shows it. Anyone else? :confused:
logan: Not expected. Our model-side listing should pull savedviews that reference the model. Likely lost during migration to per-scope rows.
mike: backend: we only populate route_index for now. model_index was planned but skipped to ship faster.
rachel: UX: users expect consistency. If a view mentions a model, it should be discoverable from model pages. But we must be clear about who can edit and who gets billed.
ellesworth: telemetry & quota concerns: if we auto-surface, do we create extra quota usage? We shouldn't. Quotas must count at creation against a single charge_target.
anya: suggestion: add scopes array to savedview (route, model, org), plus charge_target field. Listing rule: surface if current_context matches any scope or if model/route refs include current entity. Enforce ACLs server-side.
logan: implementation: add a small visibility_bitmap per row and a GSI on model_refs for fast lookup. UI can read bitmap to pre-filter before ACL check.
mike: rollout: feature flag savedview_cross_context, start internal then narrow canary. During index build we can mark staleness and show a toast "Some views may be missing while we index".
rachel: UI: display a tiny badge "origin: route /converse" when shown on other contexts, and show charge_target in save modal with ability to edit. Also show warning if chosen charge_target would exceed quota.
ellesworth: telemetry events to add: savedview.create (scopes, charge_target, origin), savedview.surface (surface_context, resolved_charge), savedview.missing_index_alert. Dashboards: surfacing_rate, quota_block_rate, cross_context_clicks.
anya: Action items: 1) Logan: API contract for scopes + charge_target. 2) Mike: prototype model GSI and visibility bitmap. 3) Nellesworth: telemetry schema + dashboard. 4) Rachel: mockups and microcopy.
logan: opened API PR 4821, will iterate.
mike: will spike index work and estimate costs.
ellesworth: will add telemetry plan and alert thresholds.
deploy-bot: feature flag savedview_cross_context enabled for 5% internal at 2025-01-08T09:30:00Z :rocket:
anya: thanks team — we'll reconvene after first canary signals.
